feature_name: Cloud Console management for attached clusters
summary: Enabled managing attached EKS and AKS clusters from Google Cloud Console, including status viewing, component updates, and detaching clusters.

evidence_snippets: For App Hub configurations, select the App Hub host project or the app-enabled folder's management project.
